title: 4-Chlorobenzylamine Containing Maleic Acid Derivatives: Synthesis, In Silico Studies, and Anti-Alzheimer's Activity.
authors: Tariq, Muhammad Junaid; Kanwal, Madiha; Ata, Athar; Nadeem, Humaira; Siddiqui, Mahwish
one_liner_zh: 该研究为马来酸衍生物的合成及抗阿尔茨海默病活性评估，涉及小分子与炎症靶蛋白的对接，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: One way to protect neurons is to protect them from oxidative damage by reducing lipid peroxidation (LPO). Therapeutic medicines that target the inflammatory response have antioxidant activities and can also block inflammatory cascade pathways and counteract cell lyses. The goal of this investigation was to see if new maleic acid derivatives could protect the brain from scopolamine-induced amnesia. To evaluate and characterize the maleic acid derivatives, spectroscopic techniques such as (1)H NMR and Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) were used. To further evaluate the synthesized compounds, an in vitro DPPH antioxidant assay was performed, compound 2f exhibited the best antioxidant potential, and along this side, an acetylcholinesterase (ACE) inhibition assay was performed. Compounds 2a and 2f showed promising results with IC(50) 20.15 and 22.09 nM, respectively. Scopolamine-treated rats trigger neurodegeneration, raise the level of antioxidant enzymes, and increase oxidative stress. The elevated levels of Tumor Necrosis Factor alpha (TNF-alpha), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), and Nuclear Factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells (NFkappaB), which are neuroinflammatory mediators, along with neuronal damage, were also seen. The anti-Alzheimer's activity of maleic acid derivatives was performed in these rats by performing the Y-maze test, Morris water maze (MWM) models, immunohistochemistry, and hematoxylin and eosin staining. In vivo antioxidant assays revealed that compounds 2a and 2f significantly restored enzymatic defenses and reduced lipid peroxidation, with 2a showing slightly superior activity. The maleic acid derivatives (2a and 2f) cause increased spontaneous changes in the rat behavior and the number of entries of rats in the Y-maze test. The observation from the MWM model showed a decrease in the escape latency time in the rats. Finally, the AutoDock Vina program was used to check ligand-protein interaction using COX-2, and TNF-alpha, JNK, NFkappaB, GSK-3beta, and ACE were used as targets.
abstract_zh: 保护神经元的一种方式是通过减少脂质过氧化（LPO）来保护它们免受氧化损伤。靶向炎症反应的治疗药物具有抗氧化活性，并能阻断炎症级联通路，对抗细胞溶解。本研究旨在探讨新型马来酸衍生物是否能保护大脑免受东莨菪碱诱导的遗忘症。采用(1)H NMR和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）等光谱技术对马来酸衍生物进行评估和表征。为进一步评估合成化合物，进行了体外DPPH抗氧化测定，其中化合物2f表现出最佳的抗氧化潜力，同时进行了乙酰胆碱酯酶（ACE）抑制测定。化合物2a和2f显示出有前景的结果，其IC(50)分别为20.15和22.09 nM。东莨菪碱处理的大鼠触发神经退行性变，提高抗氧化酶水平，并增加氧化应激。还观察到肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）、环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、Jun N末端激酶（JNK）和核因子κB（NFkappaB）等神经炎症介质的水平升高，以及神经元损伤。在这些大鼠中，通过Y迷宫测试、莫里斯水迷宫（MWM）模型、免疫组织化学和苏木精-伊红染色评估了马来酸衍生物的抗阿尔茨海默病活性。体内抗氧化测定显示，化合物2a和2f显著恢复酶防御功能并减少脂质过氧化，其中2a表现出略优的活性。马来酸衍生物（2a和2f）引起大鼠行为中自发交替次数和Y迷宫测试中进入次数的增加。MWM模型的观察结果显示，大鼠的逃逸潜伏期时间减少。最后，使用AutoDock Vina程序检查配体-蛋白质相互作用，以COX-2、TNF-alpha、JNK、NFkappaB、GSK-3beta和ACE作为靶标。
